newsitem.title: UK: Monument Oil swaps interests with Mobil.
newsitem.headline: Monument Oil swaps interests with Mobil.

text.p: Monument Oil and Gas Plc said it had agreed to swap its Argentine interests for certain North Sea assets of Mobil Corp.
The swap is not expected to change Monument's 1997 profits, the company added.
Monument's assets in Argentina include its 19.9 per cent interest in the producing Sierra Chata gas field in block CNQ10 and its 30 percent interest in exploration block CNQ7.
In return for these assets, Monument will receive the following Mobil interests:
- 19.5 percent of the Hudson field and blocks 210/24a and b in the Hudson area.
- 100 percent of block 21/28a in the Fyne area.
- 32.5 percent of block 21/27a and b in the Fyne area.
- 40 percent of block 16/18 in the Exploration block.
- 20 percent of block 13/16a in the West Captain area.
- 20 percent of block 13/21a in the West Captain area.
Monument expects the swap to be completed by the end of this year.

The British company estimates it will result in it exchanging 16.8 million barrels of oil equivalent of booked gas reserves in Argentina for 7.5 million barrels of higher margin oil reserves in Hudson in the UK.
The swap strengthens Monument's UK production base, while it consolidates its interest in the Fyne field and several other exploration prospects, Monument said.
